predictor.notes: Best validated reconstruction for integer quantities 1..1000, in GBP minor units (pence). This continuous three-tier model has a base charge of 52881 and marginal rates of 356, 143 and 79, changing after quantities 202 and 570. It matches both exact approvals: 70681 at quantity 50 and 124081 at quantity 200. All 133 additional estimates match after applying the disclosed quantization. All 18 predicted estimate-band transitions were checked on both adjacent integer quantities; further full-domain and breakpoint-neighborhood probes found no contradiction. Continuity and whole-pence marginal rates are inferred modeling assumptions, not disclosed facts. Coarse estimates do not uniquely identify hidden exact prices: alternative coefficients, nonlinear behavior or discontinuities can remain within the same bands, particularly at larger quantities. This predictor is therefore strongly supported under the three-tier interpretation, but exact recovery at every quantity is not guaranteed.
